item.title: [Lanka Talks] Seylan Bank celebrates 294th 'Pahasara' Library, bringing quality learning resources to Galgamuwa Maha Vidyalaya
item.description: Continuing its long-standing commitment to empowering future generations through education, Seylan Bank recently opened its 294th 'Pahasara' Library at Galgamuwa Maha Vidyalaya, Maharachchimulla, Narammala, marking another milestone in the Bank's flagship social sustainability initiative.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] SHRM strengthens Sri Lanka presence, appoints Oshana Dias as Country Lead
item.description: The Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM), the world’s largest HR professional association with close to 340,000 members across more than 180 countries, has strengthened its presence in Sri Lanka with dedicated local leadership and an expanded range of services for HR professionals and organisations.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Momentro Expands AI-Led Impact Across the Asia Pacific Region
item.description: Momentro has officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with IACT College, becoming a recognised Education Partner to one of Malaysia's most established institutions for marketing, advertising, communications, and creative talent.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Sri Lanka Rings the Bell for Responsible Business as UN Global Compact Launches Responsible Business Coalition
item.description: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) and the UN Global Compact today marked a significant milestone in advancing responsible business in Sri Lanka with a ceremonial Ring the Bell for Responsible Business event and the launch of the Responsible Business Coalition—a landmark partnership designed to embed sustainability, strengthened governance and the Ten Principles of the UN Global Compact across the country's business leadership.
